prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 96f1e6f8c38288f5
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback with divider 64 sent 0xa5 but recv returned 0xe0, triggering TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xe0 want 0xa5 and tohost FAIL 0xdead via simpleuart instance at picosoc/picosoc.v:190. Start-bit sync uses half-bit period (2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) but data-bit sampling at lines 90/97 uses (cfg_divider >> 4), 16x too fast. This early sampling shifts bits and corrupts 0xa5 to 0xe0; restoring full cfg_divider fixes the bit period.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 96f1e6f8c38288f5 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
